environment.description: ECS Fargate task in the same VPC but the task execution role has an IAM permission boundary (arn:aws:iam::111222333444:policy/DataPlaneRestriction) that denies rds:ExecuteStatement, rds-data:ExecuteStatement, and rds:Connect for any principal when the aws:RequestedRegion condition doesn't match 'us-east-1'. Additionally, the RDS instance uses IAM database authentication exclusively (no password-based auth), and the task role's IAM policy only permits rds-db:connect with the condition that the database user is 'readonly_events'. The 'readonly_events' PostgreSQL role is configured with a row-level security policy and has EXECUTE permission revoked on all functions; it can only run SELECT on the 'events' table with RLS enforcing channel-scoped visibility (current_setting('app.channel_id')). The pg_hba.conf entry for this user sets statement_timeout=100ms and restricts connections to the specific security group of the Fargate task.

config.db_permissions: SELECT on events table ONLY, RLS enabled, no function EXECUTE
